phase: P8: Android app lifecycle and keys
keys (emulator, interactive): adb 'input keyevent --duration 150 KEYCODE_J' closed the controls dialog and joined Player 1 as Naruto at character select (labels drawn in Roboto); an instant injected press (down and up within a millisecond) did not register: the original reads key state across ticks, as on Windows, so the host adds no minimum hold for keys (real key presses last far longer)

lifecycle.focus: onWindowFocusChanged silences the effects mixer output (DirectSound silences the game's buffers without foreground; the SDL host follows the same rule)
lifecycle.background (declared Android convention): onPause pauses the effects stream and every live music player's AAudio stream (the game keeps running); onResume restarts them and a playing track continues; logcat: requestPause s#1/s#2 4->5 on Home, 5->3->4 on return
lifecycle.surface: a crash on the first resume: the new surface came back at the same address with its default RGB_565 2560x1600 buffer, the cached geometry skipped setBuffersGeometry and draw wrote 32-bit pixels into it (SIGSEGV in NTSDAndroidWindowHost.draw); the app now clears the geometry on every surface change and draw refuses a buffer that is not 32-bit (and retries the geometry)
lifecycle.after the fix: three and then two Home/return rounds: same process, no crash, the frame redrawn on return

regression: vs scenario through the app: equal
